name: Shimena Keep
title: Shimena Keep
summary: Shimena Keep, built on Aerlinthe's north-east islet to guard the northern approaches to the Ireth Lassel research colony from Pelagian sea-nomads. The kit shows a stone bridge on 10 m piers with metal decking and blue lamps running 110 m north across the strait from the main island to a cliff-sided islet (z 30), where eight halls with rooftop turrets (to z 55.5) ring a courtyard holding a tapered tower (z 66.9, runed chests on top) and a 62 m Tall Tree; Empyrean magical defense batteries line the walls.
insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (chapter ch2).

shots.standingOrder: Lock off 2.4 m above the south shore at the bridgehead and pan 40 deg left from the bridge piers marching out to sea onto Shimena Keep and its tall tree; nothing within 13 m.
shots.notes: Shimena Keep, the castle on Aerlinthe's north-east islet that guarded Ireth Lassel from Pelagian sea-nomads: a 10 m-pier stone bridge with blue lamps crosses the strait to the walled islet (cliffs to z 30) where eight halls with rooftop turrets ring a courtyard, a tapered tower (66.9 m) and a 62 m Tall Tree. The pan starts on the near piers and ends on the keep's crown, sun behind the camera. shots.notes: Water shot along the bridge: the stone piers stream past on the left while the keep's cliff and walls rise ahead. Subject-less (looks ahead). shots.notes: Hero helix of the keep: the walled islet, its turreted halls, tower and great tree turn and drop away as the drone climbs over the strait, open sea around. Noon sun from the south.
